chunks: Yūnus, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
“The fabricator of slander is struck with a punishment between the two punishments; his whole body is struck over his clothes.”

key_terms.الْمُفْتَرِي: the one who fabricates a false accusation or slander
key_terms.بَيْنَ الضَّرْبَيْنِ: with a punishment of intermediate degree between two levels
key_terms.ثِيَابِهِ: his clothes, over which the punishment is administered
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: is struck or flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a slanderer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the punishment of one who commits false accusation or slander. It indicates a corporal punishment of intermediate severity, applied across the body while the person remains clothed.
